customer_message: I was charged twice for the same order this morning. Both charges show on my bank statement.
resolution: Confirmed the duplicate charge in the payment logs. Voided the second transaction and issued a full refund of the duplicate amount. Told the customer it appears on their statement in 3-5 business days.

customer_message: My payment keeps failing at checkout even though my card works everywhere else.
resolution: Payment was declined by the issuing bank's fraud filter. Asked the customer to approve the transaction with their bank or try another card. Payment succeeded on retry.

customer_message: The invoice I downloaded does not show our company GST number. Accounts needs it for filing.
resolution: Added the GST number to the billing profile and regenerated the invoice. Sent the corrected invoice PDF by email.

customer_message: I returned my order two weeks ago and still have not received my refund.
resolution: Checked the return: the item was received at the warehouse and the refund was issued 6 days ago. Shared the refund reference number. Bank refunds take 5-7 business days to appear.

customer_message: One of the three items in my order arrived broken. I want money back for that one.
resolution: Customer sent photos of the damage. Issued a partial refund for the damaged item only. No return needed for items under the damage threshold.

customer_message: My refund went to a credit card that I have since closed. Where does the money go?
resolution: Refunds to a closed card are redirected by the issuing bank to the linked account. Advised the customer to contact their bank with the refund reference number if it does not show within 10 business days.

customer_message: I clicked forgot password but the reset email never arrives.
resolution: The reset email was being filtered as spam. Asked the customer to check the spam folder and whitelist our domain, then triggered a new password reset link. Customer logged in successfully.

customer_message: I got a new phone and now I cannot get the two-factor code to log in.
resolution: Verified identity using the account email and last order number. Disabled two-factor authentication so the customer could log in and set it up again on the new phone.

customer_message: I need to change the email address on my account because I no longer use the old one.
resolution: Sent a verification link to the new email address. After the customer confirmed it, updated the account email and notified the old address of the change.

customer_message: Tracking says my package was delivered but I never received it.
resolution: Opened an investigation with the courier, who confirmed the package was left at the wrong door. As the parcel could not be recovered within 48 hours, shipped a replacement at no cost.

customer_message: My order was supposed to arrive three days ago and the tracking has not updated.
resolution: The courier had a regional backlog. Shared the updated delivery estimate and refunded the express shipping fee because the delivery promise was missed.

customer_message: I entered the wrong shipping address. Can you change it before it ships?
resolution: The order had not left the warehouse yet. Updated the shipping address and confirmed the change by email. Address changes are only possible before dispatch.

customer_message: The mobile app crashes every time I open it after the latest update.
resolution: Known bug in version 4.2 on older Android versions. Asked the customer to update to version 4.2.1, which fixes the crash on launch. Customer confirmed the app opens normally.

customer_message: The blender I bought does not turn on at all. It was brand new.
resolution: Defective on arrival. Sent a prepaid return label and shipped a replacement unit immediately, without waiting for the return to arrive.

customer_message: My saved lists are not syncing between my laptop and my phone.
resolution: Sync was disabled after a password change. Asked the customer to sign out and sign back in on both devices, which re-enabled sync.

customer_message: How do I cancel my subscription? I do not want to be charged again.
resolution: Cancelled the subscription at the end of the current billing period. Customer keeps access until then and will not be charged again. Sent a cancellation confirmation.

customer_message: I want to upgrade to the premium plan. Will I be charged the full price?
resolution: Upgraded the plan immediately. The customer is charged a prorated amount for the rest of the current cycle, then the full premium price from the next renewal.

customer_message: I forgot to cancel my free trial and got charged for a full year.
resolution: The charge was within 48 hours of renewal, which qualifies under the renewal policy. Cancelled the subscription and issued a full refund of the annual charge.
